description: This Kotlin source file defines the DeviceHandler class, responsible for gathering device status, info, permissions, and health data on an Android device. It includes methods to serialize device information into JSON format, check permissions, and interpret various system states such as battery, thermal, storage, network, and power management.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for collecting device information, system status, permissions, and health metrics on an Android device, then serializing data into JSON for external communication.

classes.name: BatterySnapshot
classes.description: Data class encapsulating battery status, plugged state, level, and temperature.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representing the current device status, including battery, thermal, storage, network, and uptime metrics.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with static device information such as model, manufacturer, system version, locale, app version, and build.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions
methods.description: Returns a JSON string indicating the app's current permissions for various features such as camera, location, SMS, notifications, contacts, calendar, call log, and motion sensors.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with device health metrics, including memory usage, battery state, charging type, temperature, current, and system security patch level.
